name: Iván (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, dark green, white and dark green, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Iván (a green shield with a white chevron and ears of grain) above the name IVÁN in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
